latest_validated_core_feature_head.message: Core v2: regress bounded Commons fallback in photo truth
latest_validated_core_feature_head.functional_increment: Public-safety candidate identity is now stable across first-party body/hash drift for IPJ/ISU by deriving the candidate ID from source label plus canonical source URL when no explicit story/article ID exists. The Lăpușata ISU story now carries a strongly bound, rights-cleared contextual archive photograph. PHOTO provenance also reuses the existing narrow Wikimedia Commons 429 fallback only when the independently read Commons JSON-LD identifies the exact approved filename and exposes a license; relevance and candidate binding remain fail-closed.

done: legacy remains explicitly LEGACY_NOT_PRODUCTION_READY and cannot supply Core v2 readiness
single sequential Core v2 orchestrator remains the golden-path executor; GitHub Actions remains a thin shadow executor
PHOTO remains fail-closed; generic, text-card and synthetic-as-photo substitutions remain forbidden
HCL 343, HCL 344 and HCL 345 retain their independently validated contextual archive visual approvals
ISJ 2026 retains its rights-cleared local-education contextual archive visual with strong candidate binding

a real identity defect was found through truth artifacts rather than workflow color: consecutive live shadow cycles changed ISU detail-body hashes while the canonical Lăpușata source URL represented the same story
IPJ/ISU candidate identity now prefers explicit story/article ID, otherwise derives a deterministic 24-character ID from source label plus canonical source URL instead of volatile detail-body hash
regressions prove different detail hashes for the same ISU canonical source URL resolve to the same stable candidate ID and that explicit story IDs still win
Lăpușata now has a real rights-cleared CC BY-SA 4.0 geographic archive/context visual strongly bound to the exact current ISU source/headline/who/where fingerprint
the Lăpușata disclosure explicitly states that the image does not depict the car fire, vehicle, firefighters, intervention, damage or exact incident location
natural run 561 proves PHOTO schema 1.5 with 7 candidates, 5 verified and 2 blocked; Lăpușata stable story ID d8b16613110809449b51663b passed strong binding and external provenance/image readback
the same run observed a different raw current ISU detail_id for Lăpușata, demonstrating that source-stable identity survives live detail-body drift instead of chasing transient hashes

the PHOTO gate now reuses the existing bounded Wikimedia Commons 429 fallback only if the independently read Commons page JSON-LD identifies the exact approved filename and exposes a license; wrong-asset JSON-LD remains rejected
ISJ returned an upload.wikimedia.org HTTP 429 in run 561 but remained truthfully verified because the Commons source page independently proved the exact approved asset identity and license
historical FactKernel evidence remains 2/2 and historical article-claims evidence remains 2/2 with fabricated_claims=0
historical site readback remains 2/2; CET Govora visual/Instagram approved-image identity remains verified; the water-contract transaction remains fail-closed
natural push run 561 passed contract tests, all 26 ordered shadow stages, external site/visual/Meta replay, PHOTO truth, receipts, transactions, runtime invariants and tamper regressions
no merge, deploy, live Core v2 publication, public-projection mutation, Meta write, workflow_dispatch or manual rerun was used
